lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs organized into approximately four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs to form a regular grid pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two dominant horizontal linear features on the upper flank, marked by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately six high-luminance blobs on the visible anterior portion of the first dorsal fin before the silhouette exits the frame.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular white marking or structural notch on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot size and density from high-frequency small spots on the cranial region to lower-frequency larger blobs on the mid-lateral flank.
